Terminactory is a terminal-native idle factory game written in Rust using ratatui. It includes basic factory mechanics, a research graph, a fake in-game browser with lore, and hooks to receive agent responses directly in-game.

Why it’s interesting
It combines a terminal-based idle factory game with AI agent integration to display progress updates while waiting on tasks.

Target user
Developers or users running long agent tasks who want a terminal-based game to play alongside them.

item.description:
🛠️ Yet another agent manager (but we needed it)

Summary
Logonomic is a desktop application designed to organize and manage multiple LLM CLI sessions across repositories. It features an overview mode, session management, process-surviving terminals, token usage tracking, and repository visualization tools.

Why it’s interesting
It provides a native C++ terminal emulator and dedicated management features for concurrently running multiple LLM agent CLIs.

Target user
Developers working with multiple LLM CLI agents across repositories

Business model
Free edition with terminal limits and paid perpetual one-time licenses starting from 150 euros for 2 seats
